game: GB @ ARI, 2025-10-19 16:25 ET, State Farm (roof closed). ARI +7, total 44.5, ML not in pack. GB -7 implied. Weather forecast not saved.

script.base: Book has GB leading a mid-range dome game (implied GB 25.8, ARI 18.8). Base flow: GB is ahead by a score by the second half, pace stays moderate on 44.5, and the favorite closes with the run if Josh Jacobs is active. ARI, as a +7 dog, falls into throw mode — Trey McBride (29 targets, 165 yards, 212 air in weeks 4-6) and Marvin Harrison Jr. (17/196/219) see the volume, while the ARI run committee (Michael Carter 28/86, Zonovan Knight 15/45, Trey Benson 8/35, Kyler Murray 9/66) does not pile up carries.
script.flip1: Kyler Murray (Questionable, foot) sits or is clearly limited. ARI's pass game and his 66 rush yards over three games shrink, the total leans under, GB can bleed clock, and McBride/Harrison yardage dies even if targets stay. Jacobs' carries rise only if he himself is full-go.
script.flip2: GB's own injury cluster (Jacobs illness; tackles Anthony Belton and Zach Bako-Bewele and center Jacob Monk all Questionable) keeps it close or lets ARI jump ahead. GB abandons the clock-kill, Doubs/Golden/Kraft and McBride all become live overs together, and Benson's already-small rush line dies further as ARI throws.

injury_fallout: Known before kick from the nflverse pre-game report, not inactives (90-minute window not in the pack). GB: Christian Watson Out (knee) and already absent from the week 3/4/6 target tree, so Romeo Doubs 19, Josh Jacobs 18, Matthew Golden 15, Tucker Kraft 11 and Dontayvion Wicks 10 are the current pass game, not a new Watson-out spike. Wicks is Questionable (ankle); if he sits, those 10 targets tilt to Doubs, Golden and Kraft and a Doubs under gets worse. Jacobs is Questionable (illness) — if inactive or snap-capped, Emanuel Wilson (17 carries, 80 yards in that same three-game window as the backup) is the next man, and every Jacobs leg is dead. OL Questionable: Belton (ankle), Monk (hamstring), Bako-Bewele (oblique) — if they sit, rush efficiency falls and quick throws (RB/TE catches) rise while deep WR yards fall. Defense: Devonte Wyatt Out (knee), Lukas Van Ness Out (foot); Keisean Nixon and Nate Hobbs Questionable. Brandon McManus Questionable is irrelevant to these markets. ARI: Emari Demercado Out (ankle); he is already missing from the week 4-6 rush log, so Carter/Knight/Benson/Murray already split that work and Demercado's absence is not a fresh Benson promotion. Murray Questionable (foot) is the swing piece for every ARI skill leg. Will Hernandez Questionable (knee) would further dent ARI rush efficiency and invite pressure. Zay Jones Questionable (knee) had 11 targets / 87 yards / 143 air in the L3; if inactive, McBride, Harrison, Michael Wilson (15/75/132) and Greg Dortch (10/56) absorb. Walter Nolen Out (calf) and Darius Robinson Questionable (pectoral) thin the ARI front Jacobs would run at. Kitan Crawford Questionable (ankle) is a safety — if inactive, deep shots (Harrison, Golden) get easier, not the checkdown. James Conner is not on this report and is not in the week 4-6 rush log (only three season games logged, 39/34/22); do not treat him as today's starter. Sources: pack injury report and the week-window rush/target lines.

matchup.shell: No coverage charting, man/zone rate, or MOFO/MOFC in the pack — shell is unknown. Location splits are the proxy. ARI YPA: left 5.99 (88 att), middle 8.62 (56), right 5.94 (90). GB YPA: left 5.12 (74), middle 6.9 (51), right 5.12 (73).
matchup.pressure: ARI blitzes 21%; GB EPA/db is 0.36 vs blitz and 0.29 vs none, so Love is not blitz-fragile and ARI pressure is not a reason to expect a checkdown spike. GB blitzes 22%; ARI EPA/db is 0.08 vs blitz and 0.09 vs none, so blitz rate does not separate Murray. Missing pieces that do matter: ARI Nolen Out and Robinson Q on the front Jacobs faces; GB Wyatt Out and Van Ness Out on the front Benson faces.
matchup.bleeds: ARI bleeds the middle (8.62 YPA) and the run (4.49 YPC, 20 runs of 10+ in six games) while holding the outside near 6.0 YPA. Explosives: 18 passes of 20+ for 245 yards in six games. GB is the opposite on the ground (3.62 YPC, only 7 runs of 10+ in five games) and stingy outside (5.12 both ways) with a milder middle leak (6.9). GB has allowed only 6 passes of 20+ (210 yards) in five games.
matchup.overlap: The clean overlap is Josh Jacobs' receiving role (18 targets, -24 air yards, 172 yards in three games — all underneath/YAC) into ARI's middle bleed, plus his rush into a 4.49 YPC defense down Nolen. McBride (29 targets, short-to-intermediate air) overlaps GB's middle 6.9 but only at 5.7 yards per target, so the overlap is volume not yards. Harrison's 12.9 aDOT profile does not overlap a GB defense that has allowed six 20+ passes in five games. Benson does not overlap a weak GB run front.

form: Avoid season averages; use the saved windows. Jacobs weeks 3/4/6: 56 carries, 209 rush yards (~70/game) and 18 targets, 172 rec yards (~57/game). Last4 rush 84, 30, 86, 93; rush+rec 84, 74, 157, 150; rec 0, 44, 71, 57 — the two most recent rush+rec games are 157 and 150, well above the 84.5 stand-in median. Wilson is a change-of-pace (17/80 rush; rec last4 0, 0, 37, -4). Doubs 19/138/183 in the L3 (~46 yards) with last4 28, 25, 58, 55, living under a 55.5 median and not attacking the middle. Golden trending up (last4 0, 52, 58, 86; L3 15/196/186) but as a deep piece. Kraft last4 124, 29, 56, 43 around a 43.5 median, L3 11/128. ARI: McBride last4 43, 52, 41, 72, three of four under 56.5 despite the target lead. Harrison last4 44, 66, 98, 32, volatile. Benson's week 4-6 role is 8 carries and 35 yards total, while last4 rush yards 69, 14, 42, 35 include an earlier spike that is not in that three-game total — role has shrunk. Carter, not Benson, led the L3 with 28/86 and has no prop. Conner's three logged games (39, 34, 22) are outside this window.

pro_edge.implied_totals: ARI 18.8, GB 25.8 from total 44.5 and ARI +7: favorite (44.5+7)/2 = 25.75, dog (44.5-7)/2 = 18.75. Matches the precomputed scan.
pro_edge.script_read: High-ish favorite total (25.8) supports GB RB touches more than a pass-heavy shootout. Dog total 18.8 means ARI throws to stay in it (WR/TE targets up) and the lead back does not get a clock-kill — there is no single ARI lead back in the L3 anyway. Spread of 7 is a mild late-snap risk if it becomes a blowout, not an automatic starter-yank flag. Total 44.5 is mid: not a volume-over stack and not a weather under. Roof closed, so no wind/rain drag.
pro_edge.best_price: No two-sided price saved on any listed prop; anchor no-vig N/A. Pinnacle, Circa and BetOnline are not in the pack. Power devig cannot be shown. Stand-in numbers are 2025 season-to-date medians, not shopped prices. No bet is placeable and no rung can be priced.
pro_edge.lagging: No book-versus-consensus lag flag in the precomputed scan. The stand-ins lag role changes by construction: Jacobs rush+rec median 84.5 versus ~127 combined in weeks 3/4/6, and Benson rush median 38.5 versus 8 carries / 35 yards across weeks 4-6. Treat that as a role-lag note, not a live stale book.

Watson is already out of the GB target tree, so Doubs/Golden/Kraft/Wicks medians are not unadjusted sleepers. Demercado is already out of the ARI carry log; Benson's 38.5 median was not cut to the new share (stand-in, not a book move). Jacobs is Questionable, not Out — if he is ruled out before kick, Wilson rush 18.5 is the sleeper to rerun (Wilson already 80 rush yards on 17 carries as the backup); do not play it on a Q tag. Murray is Questionable, not Out; no backup QB market in the available props.

edge_players.kills_it: Inactive or limited with the illness, Wilson takes the carries, and the leg never starts; or the Q offensive line sits and ARI takes away the flat so neither the ~70 rush nor the ~57 receiving shows up.

data_check.notes: Step 8 cannot be run. No projection, no sims, no Pinnacle (or Circa/BetOnline) no-vig, no two-sided prices. Stand-in lines are the players' own season medians, so they are not an independent market. Hand model_p values (0.55 Jacobs, 0.58 Benson) are discounted reads, not 3-sim probabilities, and anything near 70% would be untrustworthy on this history. Jacobs production data agrees with rush+rec over (L3 ~127, last two 157 and 150) but availability data disagrees: Questionable illness, plus three OL Questionable, and pure rush ~70 does not clear 84.5. That caps him at a lean and a flag, not a cut of the read and not a sized bet. Benson's recent role agrees with the under; the last4 69 and 42 disagree and look like the pre-cut role. Inactives are not in the pack. No leg is confirmed.

Benson rush under 38.5, not rush+rec (L3 rush+rec is about 54, essentially the 52.5 stand-in). No alt rungs and no prices saved. Short-priced alts are not available and would not be taken anyway. Candidates only.
pre_mortem: It's Monday and both lost. Jacobs was inactive or on a snap count with the illness, Wilson took the carries, and 84.5 rush+rec never had a body; or he played, the Questionable tackles and center sat, ARI squeezed the flat, and the 172-yard receiving sample was a three-game hot streak (the last4 also has 84 and 74). Benson lost because the staff — with Conner not in the recent log and Demercado out — finally gave him the lead job, he saw 12-plus carries, and one run of 10+ against a GB front missing Wyatt and Van Ness pushed him through 38.5. Those counters are strong enough to keep both at lean and unsized, not strong enough to erase the role gaps if the pre-kick statuses hold.
slip_story: One story only: GB controls a closed-roof game in the mid-20s, Jacobs (if active) is the touch monster on the ground and in the flat, and ARI never establishes a second back so Benson stays a small share against a 3.62 YPC defense. Do not add Doubs or Golden overs, a total over, or a McBride over — those need GB to throw or ARI to move the ball, which is flip 2, not the base. No TDs, one market per player, two legs. Not a bet. Re-run if Jacobs or Murray is inactive.
